categories.name: Minimalist abstract backgrounds
categories.desc: Clean, spacious geometric planes with ultra-subtle tone-on-tone shadows

categories.name: Dark AMOLED backgrounds
categories.desc: Pure #000000 deep black backgrounds with hyper-focused micro-contrast accents

categories.name: Light editorial backgrounds
categories.desc: Off-white paper tones (#fcfcfc, #fafafa) with razor-sharp hairline borders

categories.name: Soft pastel backgrounds
categories.desc: Gentle, soothing pastel gradients with serene chromatic transitions

categories.name: Premium gradient backgrounds
categories.desc: High-end multi-stop radial and conic gradients with rich color harmony

categories.name: Animated gradient backgrounds
categories.desc: Hardware-accelerated continuous color shifts using CSS keyframes and matrix transforms

categories.name: Mesh gradients
categories.desc: Multi-point organic mesh gradients simulating silk and flowing pigments

categories.name: Aurora and northern-light effects
categories.desc: Ethereal luminous polar light waves drifting across dark atmospheric skies

categories.name: Japanese-inspired backgrounds
categories.desc: Seigaiha waves, Asanoha hemp leaves, and traditional Japanese geometric patterns

categories.name: Anime-inspired backgrounds
categories.desc: Dynamic cel-shaded rays, speed lines, and vibrant anime backdrop layers

categories.name: Manga panel textures
categories.desc: Ben-Day dot screen tones, screentone screencuts, and manga layout gridlines

categories.name: Japanese ink and brush textures
categories.desc: Sumi-e charcoal washes, water bleeding, and dry brush strokes in high-res vector

categories.name: Cherry blossom-inspired scenes
categories.desc: Delicate sakura petals drifting with subtle physics and spring wind vectors

categories.name: Mountain and landscape illustrations
categories.desc: Layered silhouette ranges with atmospheric haze and sunrise horizons

categories.name: Cyberpunk city backgrounds
categories.desc: Neon skyscrapers, rain-soaked reflections, holographic billboards, and fog

categories.name: Futuristic grid backgrounds
categories.desc: Perspective 3D wireframe ground planes receding toward digital horizons

categories.name: Sci-fi starfields
categories.desc: Multi-depth parallax star clusters, twinkling constellations, and cosmic dust

categories.name: Space and galaxy backgrounds
categories.desc: Spiral galaxy arms, deep-field star clusters, and cosmic horizon vistas

categories.name: Nebula and cosmic textures
categories.desc: Volumetric stellar gas clouds, interstellar ionization, and glowing dust plumes

categories.name: Animated planetary scenes
categories.desc: Rotating wireframe spheres, orbit trajectories, and eclipse shadows

categories.name: Particle fields
categories.desc: Lightweight HTML5 Canvas interactive particle networks connected by spring lines

categories.name: Floating geometric shapes
categories.desc: Drifting glassmorphic polyhedra, cubes, and rings reacting to mouse movement

categories.name: Organic blob backgrounds
categories.desc: Morphing SVG metaballs with liquid physics and cubic bezier keyframes

categories.name: Fluid and liquid-inspired backgrounds
categories.desc: Viscous chromatic liquid simulations with caustic light refraction

categories.name: SVG wave backgrounds
categories.desc: Multi-layered sinusoidal vector waves with layered transparency and wave-height shifts

categories.name: Layered SVG illustrations
categories.desc: Scalable multi-plane scenic illustrations optimized for parallax scroll

categories.name: Procedural line patterns
categories.desc: Mathematical Lissajous curves, Moire interference, and harmonic vector tracks

categories.name: Dot and halftone patterns
categories.desc: Modern geometric dot matrices, halftone grids, and architectural alignment points

categories.name: Grain and noise textures
categories.desc: High-fidelity SVG noise filters and CSS blend-modes adding organic analog depth

categories.name: Paper and print textures
categories.desc: Tactile fiber parchment, washi paper, and risograph stippling effects

categories.name: Glass and frosted surfaces
categories.desc: Multi-layer backdrop-filter blur, specular highlights, and refraction borders

categories.name: Metallic textures
categories.desc: Brushed titanium, anodized aluminum, and reflective metallic sheen gradients

categories.name: Liquid chrome effects
categories.desc: Hyper-reflective mercury flows, molten silver curves, and metallic distortion

categories.name: Holographic effects
categories.desc: Iridescent prism shifts that shimmer with mouse angle or gyroscope tilt

categories.name: Glow and bloom backgrounds
categories.desc: Soft diffuse lighting nodes, neon halos, and atmospheric optical bloom

categories.name: Interactive spotlight backgrounds
categories.desc: Radial illumination mask following mouse cursor coordinates with smooth damping

categories.name: Cursor-reactive backgrounds
categories.desc: Magnetic vector fields, repulsion nodes, and reactive fluid trails

categories.name: Scroll-reactive backgrounds
categories.desc: Transitions tied directly to window.scrollY or CSS scroll-timeline progress

categories.name: Parallax landscapes
categories.desc: Multi-plane vector landscapes scrolling at offset velocity coefficients

categories.name: Animated geometric backgrounds
categories.desc: Kaleidoscopic rotating polygons, tessellations, and architectural unfolds

categories.name: Botanical and floral backgrounds
categories.desc: Stylized monstera leaves, creeping vines, and organic floral silhouettes

categories.name: Ocean and underwater scenes
categories.desc: Deep sea abyss, caustic sunbeams penetrating water, and buoyant bubbles

categories.name: Mountain and natural landscapes
categories.desc: Contour topographic elevation lines and alpine ridge silhouettes

categories.name: Retro synthwave backgrounds
categories.desc: Outrun sunsets, neon grid roads, chrome horizons, and palm silhouettes

categories.name: Pixel-art backgrounds
categories.desc: Isometric micro-cities, 8-bit skyboxes, and retro CRT scanline backdrops

categories.name: Brutalist editorial textures
categories.desc: Raw concrete stippling, stark typography watermarks, and industrial grids

categories.name: Luxury monochrome backgrounds
categories.desc: Opulent deep charcoal and platinum contrasts with fine geometric motifs

categories.name: Minimal technical diagrams
categories.desc: Precision blueprint schematics, coordinate rulers, and architectural axes

categories.name: Architectural line art
categories.desc: Axonometric building plans, structural elevations, and isometric facades

categories.name: 3D abstract environments
categories.desc: Three.js / WebGL generative ribbons, low-poly terrains, and spatial shaders
